findings.title: Occurrence context drops the schedule_type display rewrite
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config and, when schedule_type is present, replaces it with get_schedule_type_display() on that copy. The dict it returns still passes monitor_environment.monitor.config, the original mapping, so the rewritten copy is discarded. Issue occurrences therefore keep the raw schedule_type value (typically an integer choice) in the monitor context instead of the human-readable label the copy was built to provide.
